summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (39 passed) under the shared venv. Nothing was committed and the venv was not modified. Not verified: black, isort, and mypy are not installed in the shared venv, so formatting, line lengths, and type-ignore placement were checked by reading the code only. Choices made: a Node isinstance guard rejects None and plain strings before any graph lookup; blank nodes are any remaining Node since BNode is not on the allowed import list; one extra test covers non-node inputs.
